name: Blue Natural Capital Financing Facility (BNCFF)

funder.name: Government of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

summary: IUCN-managed facility, funded by Luxembourg, that gives early-stage grants and support to coastal and marine conservation and restoration projects with a path to financial sustainability; Phase III selects projects through an expression of interest.

calls.label: BNCFF Phase III Expression of Interest

status.quote: An Expression of Interest (EOI) is currently open for project developers in Cabo Verde, São Tomé and Príncipe, Costa Rica, the Philippines, and Vanuatu.

administered_by.quote: Launched in 2018, the BNCFF is supported by the Government of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and is managed by IUCN.

geography.quote: An Expression of Interest (EOI) is currently open for project developers in Cabo Verde, São Tomé and Príncipe, Costa Rica, the Philippines, and Vanuatu.

access.quote: Phase 1: Expression of Interest (EOI), submitted through this Microsoft form.

amount.quote: The indicative budget range for projects is €50,000 - €200,000.
